title: Kimi K3.1 Pro released as post-training refinement with Highspeed option
summary: Moonshot rolled out Kimi K3.1 Pro across Kimi, Kimi Work, and Kimi Code as an RL-scaled post-training update.
research_notes:
Access the model interactively through the Kimi web application, Kimi Work, or Kimi Code.

Call the kimi-k3.1-pro model endpoint through the Moonshot Open Platform API for standard inference at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens.

Select the Highspeed API variant for workloads requiring two to three times faster generation at doubled token rates.

Use the 1M-token context window to ingest entire multi-file codebases and complex CAD/3D asset configurations in a single session.

Specify targeted engine and script conventions when prompting for Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot, or Three.js procedural generation.

Route high-throughput, latency-critical interactive tasks to the Highspeed endpoint while keeping complex offline reasoning on the standard tier to control inference costs.
